title: Mixed Event — Secret Operation Valentine's Day — Episode5 Let's Make Sweets♪

meta.Event Outline: With Valentine's Day just on the horizon, Airi is planning a surprise for everyone to show them her gratitude. She happens to meet Saki and Emu, who both had similar ideas, and they form a Secret Valentine's Day Alliance.

rows.Line: A few hours earlier
Tenma Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Airi, Emu, welcome to my house!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thanks for having us!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, thanks for inviting us over!
Still, Saki, your house is so big!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh stop!
But...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
...?
Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's just... I can't help but feel a little anxious since you're really here at my house, Airi...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad you're so excited about having me over, but we have a busy day ahead of us and don't have a minute to waste!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So let's make sure our chocolate cakes put a smile on everyone's faces!

rows.Speaker: Emu & Saki
rows.Line: Yeah!
Tenma Household - Kitchen

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Wow, your kitchen's also pretty big!
There should be more than enough space for us to bake our sweets!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
What are we gonna start with, Airi?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The sponge cake base is gonna take up the most time, so we'll start by baking those. After that, we can start making decorations and stuff for them.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Right, because it's the basis for everything we're doing! But it still seems really hard...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I know.
But there's no show without a stage, so we'll need to make ours before anything else can happen!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I get it!
Because there's no show without the Wonder Stage!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, I'm gonna do my best!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I need... One, two, three eggs...
A pinch of sugar and... Done!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
So we whisk the eggs now?
That sounds really fun! I wanna try!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Be careful when using an electric mixer. Things are gonna start flying all over the place if you don't keep a close eye on what you're doing.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yes, ma'am!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Once you feel the dough's nice and mixed, can I have you start working on the cookies?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, I've made some before so I know how!
Except, I remember having some trouble kneading the dough...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Saki! Saki!
I'll help you☆

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You will? Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yay♪ I'll go get the flour and stuff!
Be right back!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay, cookie cutting complete...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hey, those look really cute!
Why don't we start making the marzipan next?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Marzipan...? Isn't that the stuff they use to make the edible Santa Clause dolls you see on top of Christmas cakes?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yup. My plan's to make dolls of everyone from MORE MORE JUMP! for the top of my cake.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You know how to make edible dolls? That's so cool, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Um... Can I try helping with that?
I know your cake means a lot to you, so I wanna lend a hand where I can...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Thanks!
In that case, we can work on it together!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay! I promise to try my best!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So add a couple of drops of red food coloring to the marzipan and... Oh no! I put in too much! It turned bright red!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's okay. Marzipan's pretty easy to make, so you can just try again with a fresh batch.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
As for this red marzipan... Hmm...
What if I turned them into hearts for us to use as extra decorations?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You'd do that?
You're a lifesaver, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
The macarons seem ready too.
And it looks like none of them broke!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow! They're perfectly baked!
They really look like plushies!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Emu, can you start piping the ganache onto the macarons? They don't need much so go a little bit at a time, okay?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Okay!
A little bit♪ A little bit♪ A little bit of love♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Haha♪
Oh, Emu. Singing while piping ganache!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe♪ I can't help it!
Everything feels so sweet and delicious right now!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I even talked about doing a really sweet show with everyone the other day♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
A sweet show...?
I wonder what that would be like.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Sweet♪ Sweet♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. Looks like our chocolate cakes are gonna turn out amazing, and it's all thanks to you, Airi♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But... I'd like to be able to bake one on my own next time.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, why's that?
I'll always be willing to help, you know?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: A-As tempting as your offer is...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm always relying on my friends for help, especially during band practice since I'll run out of stamina sometimes...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Which is why I want to learn to be able to bake and make gifts like this on my own one day!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You want to give back to others all on your own... There are times when I want to accomplish something by myself, so I totally get how you feel.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But it's also okay to ask for help when things get tough.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Idols aren't exempt from that either. There are plenty of things that we can't do on our own, but we're able to grow because we have each other.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Things that you can't do on your own...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm not saying it's bad to set out on your own. I'm saying that you're not alone and you can always ask for help whenever you think you need it.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Be it baking sweets or anything else, we can try everything together!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, you're absolutely right.
I convinced myself somewhere along the way that I had to be able to stand on my own.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
But this is why you're the best, Airi!
You're sparkling just the way you did on TV... No, I think you're even brighter than before!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm so happy that I got to meet you...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm not that great or anything, but thanks, I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Stand the cookies up like this...
And add a couple of dragees...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hmm...
How should I line up all the plushies...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: They're so focused...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Rin, you can take a peek now, but try to be discrete, okay?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<I'm here♪
Hehe. I snuck out of dance practice to see this♪>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Oh wow!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, what do you think? Baking looks fun, right?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Yeah! And your cake's adorable, Airi!
It looks just like a stage for idols!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<It even looks delicious.
I'm sure everyone will love it!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thanks.
I'll be making some for you too, so you'll have that to look forward to.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Yay♪
Thank you so much, Airi!>
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Is something the matter?
You two seemed awfully startled when you were by the intersection just now.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki seems to be acting a little strange is all...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Saki is?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I was told that Ichika and the others would be going over to our house...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But she seems to have told them that she won't be able to make band practice because she had a family outing to attend to...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I see...
But why would Saki ever lie like that...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I have no idea...
Nothing like this has ever happened before...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(Oh, so yesterday...
I may not have been imagining things. That really might've been Airi.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Arrgh! This isn't getting us anywhere!
Let's just call her!

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Tenma Household - Kitchen

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Phew... I'm done decorating mine!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Me too! Me too! That was so much fun☆

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Great work, you two.
Those look really amazing!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Now we just need wrap it in plastic after everything hardens and settles. Make sure not to touch it once we do that, alright?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay, I'll start doing the dishes in the meantime... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Saki, your phone's ringing.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, it is.
Tsukasa's calling...
But why?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hello?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: <Saki, where are you right now?!>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What's wrong, Tsukasa?
I'm at home like I said...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line:
<What's wrong?!
I bumped into Ichika just now and she said that she has band practice today...>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: <But she also said that you wouldn't be able to make it because we were going somewhere as a family. Why did you lie to us like that?>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I, um.. Well...! It's just...
Some things came up and...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
What's going on, Saki?
Is everything alright?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shh! Not now!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line:
<Hm? Who was that just now?
You're with someone, aren't you?>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, I'm just... Uhh...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku's Voice
rows.Line: <Is Airi there with you by chance...?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika's Voice
rows.Line: <What? Momoi's with her?>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I-Ichi? And was that Shizuku?)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ts-Tsukasa!
There's nothing for you to worry about!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We're... I'm not doing anything suspicious... Oh no!
se_event_valentine_2022_001

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: <Saki?!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Are you okay, Saki?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Y-Yeah. The bowl just fell and...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line:
<Are you in some kind of trouble?!
I'm heading home right now, so sit tight!>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, Tsukasa... H-He hung up!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What happened, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
This is bad! What do we do?!
Tsukasa said he's coming home!

rows.Speaker: Airi & Emu
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Also, it sounded like Ichi and Shizuku were there with him...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, that means they might all come here together...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh no!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What do we do, Airi?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We have to hide our cakes!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: B-But we're not supposed to move them, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Right. We can't box them up or put them in the fridge yet. If they do actually all come here, it's game over...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Noooo! Isn't there anything we can do?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
(Sounds like they're in trouble...!
Isn't there anything I can do to help them...?)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Oh, I know! Hey, Airi...!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Rin...?
